#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point5 {
    int a, b, c, d, e;
    Point5() {}
    Point5(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) : a(a), b(b), c(c), d(d), e(e) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n >= 100) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    Point5 p[105];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        int a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        p[i] = Point5(a, b, c, d, e);
    }

    set<int> bad;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
                if (i == j || j == k || k == i) continue;

                long long ax = p[j].a - p[i].a;
                long long bx = p[j].b - p[i].b;
                long long cx = p[j].c - p[i].c;
                long long dx = p[j].d - p[i].d;
                long long ex = p[j].e - p[i].e;

                long long ay = p[k].a - p[i].a;
                long long by = p[k].b - p[i].b;
                long long cy = p[k].c - p[i].c;
                long long dy = p[k].d - p[i].d;
                long long ey = p[k].e - p[i].e;

                double val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey;
                long long m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex;
                long long m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey;
                val = val / sqrt((double)m1);
                val = val / sqrt((double)m2);

                if (acos(val) * 180.0 / M_PI + 1e-9 < 90.0) {
                    bad.insert(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << n - (int)bad.size() << "\n";
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (bad.find(i) == bad.end()) {
            cout << i << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
